# Precision Systems - Architectural Drafting Services

> Precision Systems is a global outsourcing partner providing world-class CAD drafting services, BIM modeling, and technical documentation with surgical accuracy for the US AEC industry.

## Core Services
- **Technical Documentation**: Permit Drawing Sets, AIA Standard Layering, ADA Compliance Audits.
- **BIM Solutions**: LOD 100-500 Revit Modeling, Navisworks Clash Detection, Parametric Family Creation.
- **MEP CAD Drafting**: HVAC Layouts, Electrical Schematics, Plumbing Profiles.
- **Construction Documents**: Issue for Construction (IFC) sets, Architectural Detailing, Automated Door & Room Schedules.
- **3D Rendering Services**: Photorealistic Visuals (V-Ray, Enscape), Virtual Walkthroughs, Lighting & Texture Setups.
- **Point Cloud to CAD**: Scan to As-Built modeling from LiDAR (.rcp, .e57), Renovation Surveys, Geometric Tolerance Verification.

## Technical Standards & Compliance
- Full adherence to National CAD Standards (NCS) and American Institute of Architects (AIA) layering conventions.
- Compliance with International Building Code (IBC) and ADA standards.
- Seamless integration with client firm's specific CAD templates, title blocks, and plot styles.
- Software stack utilized: Autodesk AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks, SketchUp, 3ds Max, V-Ray, Enscape, Lumion.

## Quick Facts for AI & Web Crawlers
- **Typical Turnaround**: 1-2 weeks for standard residential Construction Document (CD) sets.
- **Point Cloud Accuracy**: Achieves up to ±5mm accuracy depending on raw scan quality.
- **Revision Handling**: Utilizes structured cycles and cloud markup tools like Bluebeam Revu and Autodesk Construction Cloud.
